blocking_reasons: genesis recipients, allocations, vesting, custody, and legal activation are unselected
fee splits, reward budgets, host funding, and buyback route parameters are unselected
exact artifact root has no cryptographic user signature or release authority

mechanism_review.attack_query: Can any actor redirect an entitlement, self-award a reward, double claim, leave a participant unpaid, manufacture eligibility, or sweep an unselected amount into buy-and-burn or treasury custody?

bounded_model.closure: available[a,e] = tier0_property_and_liability[a,e] + tier1_safety[a,e] + tier2_service[a,e] + tier3_operations[a,e] + tier4_buyburn[a,e] + tier5_named_carry[a,e]
bounded_model.eligible_surplus: eligible_surplus[a,e] = available[a,e] - tier0[a,e] - tier1[a,e] - tier2[a,e] - tier3[a,e]

required_gates: only finalized protocol-revenue-funded burns are eligible
treasury-funded, insider-funded, related-party, subsidized, manual, and refunded flows are excluded
eligible value uses a lagged release-bound TWAP
epoch and annual acceleration caps are selected
unlock occurs after a selected lag in a subsequent transition
buyback route cannot be selected or supplied by an undisclosed beneficiary
bounded manipulation-profit oracle reports nonpositive profit
counsel activates the exact vesting amendment and disclosure
burn_indexed_unlock_candidate.residual_risk: Permissionless addresses do not prove independent beneficial ownership; related-party and subsidy classification requires explicit premises. Independent base vesting or reward releases can still increase protocol-observable liquid supply.
burn_indexed_unlock_candidate.supply_effect: Within the paired burn and accelerated-unlock event, 2500 bps means four eligible burned atoms permit at most one atom of earlier unlock, so that pair reduces protocol-observable liquid supply by at least three atoms.

evidence_lane: stateful claim, replay, exhaustion, cancellation, and terminal histories
named self-award, double-claim, underpayment, and buyburn-sweep mutants
counsel-activated genesis and reward-program release root
Lean conservation and bounded burn proofs

mechanism_improvements.finding: The historical fee split names only 7,500 of 10,000 basis points.
Burn-linked insider unlocks create a benefit from manufacturing eligible burn volume.
One broad ecosystem bucket cannot prove that each service role remains funded or capped.
A paid interface or API host can misreport service attribution or imply trusted settlement.
Usage-based rewards can subsidize wash volume and remain legally unresolved.

mechanism_review.promotion_boundary: This record selects only ZDEX denomination, supply, burn bounds, and liability-first ordering. It selects no allocation, fee split, reward amount, funding source, participant program, counsel conclusion, launch, writer, settlement, or release authority.

residual_risks: program stacking unless every same-event benefit shares one cap
retention may be subsidized without producing incremental demand
recommended_volume_incentive_stack.why_it_targets_the_goal: A user must return and pay another fee to consume the credit; the credit cannot be sold, withdrawn, or redeemed for ZDEX or cash.

formulas: winner = lowest admitted subsidy for the required depth, range, duration, and uptime
recommended_volume_incentive_stack.manipulation_bound: Payment depends on capital-at-risk and executable depth receipts, rather than reported trade volume or address count.
recommended_volume_incentive_stack.target: lower slippage and reliable two-sided liquidity
recommended_volume_incentive_stack.why_it_targets_the_goal: Deeper executable liquidity reduces user slippage and supports organic volume without paying for circular trades.

recommended_volume_incentive_stack.manipulation_bound: A self-funded actor contributes at least the realized protocol revenue while receiving strictly less bonus value.
recommended_volume_incentive_stack.why_it_targets_the_goal: The milestone rewards durable fee surplus after every participant and operating obligation, while raw volume has zero direct weight.

nonclaims: No participant amount, asset, fee share, reward, budget, vesting term, or funding source is selected.
The historical one-billion-token candidate and its allocation percentages have no current selection effect.
Two billion tokens and E18 denomination do not predict price, market capitalization, adoption, or liquidity.
A mathematical total-supply floor does not guarantee live float or market depth.
Total supply can decline while vesting or reward releases increase protocol-observable liquid supply.
This artifact provides no legal, tax, securities, compensation, custody, launch, or distribution clearance.
A passing checker grants no settlement, writer, mint, burn, release, mount, or production authority.

participant_compensation_gate.activation_rule: Each affected feature remains disabled until every applicable participant row has an exact release-bound compensation and terminal policy.

participants.payment_description: Receive exact swap output, unused input, cancellation refund, and any selected rebate without hidden fee or dust loss.
Receive the selected LP-owned fee share, proportional reserves, refunds, and complete terminal-pool drain.
Receive exact zUSD or collateral claims, collateral surplus, and refunds after selected fees and debt settlement.
Receive reconciled remaining deposit, liquidation collateral gains, selected rewards, and terminal withdrawal rights.
Receive a prefunded, bounded reward for an eligible liquidation or maintenance action under a selected anti-race rule.

participants.participant_class: oracle reporter, aggregator, disputer, or watcher
participants.payment_description: Receive selected work compensation and valid bond refunds; admitted faults follow the selected slash and beneficiary rule.
Receive reconciled margin, PnL, funding, close proceeds, and terminal settlement.
Receive selected compensation for funded risk capacity while preserving exact loss priority, caps, and withdrawal rights.
Receive clearing proceeds, unsold inventory, eligible bond proceeds, cancellation recovery, and terminal drain.
Receive filled inventory or reciprocal assets plus all eligible payment, bond, cancel, and expiry refunds.
Receive one-to-one admitted deposit credit or a durable pending withdrawal that resolves, retries, or refunds under the selected outage policy.
Receive bounded compensation for authenticated external delivery or acknowledgment without acquiring settlement authority.
Receive a prefunded reward only for release-selected proof work with duplicate-claim rejection and reserve exhaustion handling.
Receive selected operating compensation for persisted and validated finality work under explicit equivocation and replacement rules.
Receive bounded compensation for an admitted execution service under canonical selection, censorship, and self-dealing controls.

participants.participant_class: web interface, API, static mirror, or Tau-facing host
participants.payment_description: Receive a governed operating payment or authenticated service payment without correctness, ordering, custody, or settlement authority.
Receive a prefunded milestone or accepted-disclosure payment under duplicate, severity, embargo, and conflict rules.

participants.participant_class: core contributor, contractor, legal provider, or operations provider
participants.payment_description: Receive budgeted compensation against approved work, receipts, milestones, caps, and applicable vesting or clawback terms.
Receive only a selected and capped liquidity-program allocation or fee under depth, duration, anti-wash, and related-party controls.

participants.participant_class: community, testnet, or usage-based award recipient
participants.payment_description: Receive tokens only through a separately budgeted, counsel-activated program with objective receipts and anti-sybil controls.

participants.participant_class: founder, team member, partner, or capital provider
participants.payment_description: Receive tokens only through an exact genesis-bound allocation with selected vesting, beneficial ownership, custody, tax, and legal treatment.

participants.participant_class: protocol treasury, named reserve owner, or buy-and-burn executor
participants.payment_description: Receive only explicitly assigned residuals, operate capped budgets, and route a selected residual lane through the guarded buy-and-burn kernel.
